verdict.rationale: The UK IPO's digital services (online filing, trade mark search, renewals) could plausibly offer a natural-language or conversational interface, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents forms, keyword/number/owner search, and email or post submission. Keyword search is an adjacent feature, not natural-language command operation, so no support is credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
